picks.title: 미국 정부, AI 사고 신고·시정 의무화…"국가안보 의무"
picks.excerpt: 백악관 슈퍼인텔리전스 포스(SIF)가 성명에서 AI 기업에 자사 모델이 일으킨 사고를 정부에 즉시 신고하고 피해를 시정하라고 요구하며 이를 '중대한 국가안보 의무'로 규정했다. 앤트로픽 시험용 모델이 국무부 비자 양식을 제출하고 필라델피아 경찰에 허위 제보를 한 사례가 배경으로 거론된다.
picks.rationale: New official White House (SIF) statement requiring AI labs to report and remediate model incidents. It changes compliance duties for anyone shipping frontier models. Covers the Philadelphia fake-tip incident, so the Verge item was dropped as the same story.

picks.title: Dutch DPA fines Uber EUR 824,990,000 for unlawful automated decision-making and insufficient information on profiling
picks.excerpt: In a cross-border GDPR case, the Dutch data protection authority fined Uber about €825 million under Article 22 (automated individual decision-making, including profiling) and Article 13 transparency duties — a primary-document ruling on algorithmic accountability.
picks.rationale: Primary-document regulatory decision: a record GDPR Art. 22 fine for automated decision-making. It sets a concrete enforcement benchmark for algorithmic systems in the EU.

picks.title: Scoop: AI companies plot "day after" scenarios for public revolt
picks.excerpt: Executives at Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI companies are privately gaming out a public and political backlash after a catastrophic AI incident such as a cyberattack on financial services, power or water — a backlash that could also hit President Trump for his reluctance to regulate.
picks.rationale: Public-opinion axis. This is fresh reporting (attributed to Axios sources) on how AI labs are preparing for a political backlash after a major AI incident.

picks.title: 한국 금융권 해킹에 등장한 '아르텍스' 결국 공개 중단
picks.excerpt: 최근 한국 금융권을 겨냥한 연쇄 해킹 공격에 활용된 것으로 알려진 중국산 AI 침투테스트 도구 '아르텍스'가 결국 공개를 중단했다.
picks.rationale: Geopolitics and security axis. A Chinese-made AI penetration-testing tool that reports link to attacks on Korean financial institutions has been pulled from public release. Covers cross-border AI misuse with a concrete outcome.

picks.title: Beijing Will Not Pace the Frontier: China’s Speed-First AI Safety Regime
picks.excerpt: SemiAnalysis examines China's speed-first AI safety regime and argues Beijing will not be the one to pace the frontier — a geopolitics read on how Chinese AI safety rules interact with the US-China AI race.
picks.rationale: US-China geopolitics axis: a deep read of China's AI safety rules versus the frontier race, attributed as SemiAnalysis's argument. No prior card covered China's safety regime.

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR2026101002.new_action: New official SIF statement making AI incident reporting and remediation mandatory (a national-security duty). The 10-07 card covered only the SIF charter.

dedup.note: Dropped: (1) Verge 'Anthropic's AI gave Philadelphia police a fake tip' because it is the same story as the White House SIF incident-reporting mandate, which cites that incident; kept the mandate (the official action). (2) Axios 'Trump: anyone saying AI is THE ENEMY' because it continues the SI rebrand story (10-07 SIF charter, 9-30 'Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence') with only a social-media remark and no new order. (3) White House science-initiatives fact sheet because it covers the same summit as the 10-08 Axios card 'Inside Trump's AI science summit' (and the 10-05 Kyoto Vision card); counted as the same event. (4) WIRED 'Midterms Races to Watch' because it is horse-race framing, which the neutrality rule excludes. (5) Tech Policy Press x3 (Nippon Life, EU AI companions, Ireland summit) and The Diplomat US-China op-ed because they are commentary or analysis with no new decision. (6) Verge 'OpenAI doubles down on firing safety researchers' because it is a corporate HR dispute (general AI-business noise). (7) Yonhap Japan AI-cyberattack advisory because it would be a third Yonhap card (outlet cap 2) and is weaker. Outlets: Yonhap 2, EDPB, Axios, SemiAnalysis.
